# Fast Transients = Monster OODA loops.
You’re disoriented if you feel like you have to slow down and speed up at the same time. It means the pace layers of your mental models aren’t separated and laminar.  They’re turbulent and tangled. This is not entirely bad. Layers need to mix for a while to distribute information signals at the right levels sometimes as you reorient, and it’s a part of fast transients. You need to tolerate some psyche management stress just as pilots have to tolerate high g forces briefly when making aggressive maneuvers. This is similar to how in the gramsci gap there are monsters.
